Portulacaceae.key_door: succulent Portulaca + 2 sepals + circumscissile lid-opening capsule

Talinaceae.key_door: succulent/tuberous habit + 2 sepals + superior ovary + longitudinally valved capsule

Phytolaccaceae.key_door: pokeweed raceme + apetalous flower + multi-carpellate berry

Petiveriaceae.key_door: Rivina raceme + 4-part apetalous flower + single-carpel red berry

Plumbaginaceae.key_door: persistent tubular calyx + stamens opposite petals + single ovule

Tamaricaceae.key_door: scale-leaved woody branchlets + small racemes + tufted seeds

lineage_lesson: Caryophyllales B adds six smaller branches that make the order easier to recognize as a radiation of very different reproductive solutions rather than one visual type.
taxonomy_notes: Current Kew accepts Talinum aurantiacum and treats Phemeranthus aurantiacus as a synonym.
Current POWO/APG IV accepts Petiveriaceae and places Rivina there; older floras may include Rivina in broad Phytolaccaceae.
Current Kew distributions treat Tamarix aphylla and T. ramosissima as introduced in Texas.
Ceratostigma plumbaginoides is a Chinese-native horticultural comparison, not a Central Texas native anchor.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Use close-family comparisons before unrelated visual lookalikes.
Keep introduced/comparison status separate from family-identification value.
